name: detect termination by a conserved weight
mechanism: the controller holds weight 1; every message carries a share of the sender's weight; an idle node returns its weight to the controller; when the controller's weight returns to 1 nothing is active or in flight

sources.ref: List of algorithms (revid 1373672109), entry 'Huang's algorithm' in section Distributed systems algorithms:

requires: exact arithmetic on weights (or rational shares)
